svg.title: Constructed overlap and contention evidence
svg.desc: During a concurrent scenario H2D runs zero to fifty five microseconds and D2H ten to seventy. Their overlap is forty five and joined makespan seventy. Isolated forty and fifty microsecond costs sum to ninety, so twenty saved against that sum is different from the observed concurrent intersection.

g.text: Concurrent interval overlap differs from savings against isolated costs
Constructed times in µs; independent buffers and a complete two-stream join
Concurrent intersection: [10,55] = 45 µs. Joined makespan: 70 µs.
Separate isolated costs: 40 + 50 = 90 µs. Saving versus that sum: 20 µs.
Concurrent durations changed: overlap is not the same quantity as saved time.
Capability and separate streams permit a test; only captured evidence shows overlap.
